dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Visible as thin, pale-gray margins along the edges of the folded secondary and primary feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: A distinct, roughly oval-shaped patch of rufous/brown plumage is visible on the posterior crown and upper nape.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Indistinct; the gray plumage of the crown transitions into the mantle without a visible linear boundary.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent, high-contrast white rectangular spots arranged in transverse bands on the black tail feathers; pinkish-red coloration on the distal portion of the beak.
